name: loom-code
description: Five stations carry one change from plan to PR with content-bound verification, one closing review, and a fast publication gate. Claude Code + Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Five-station coding flow with a deterministic push gate, for Codex CLI
interface.longDescription: Carries one change from a confirmed intent to a pull request through five stations. Review runs the package suite and adversarial programs once, then generates an attestation bound to functional content. The installed plugin hook validates that attestation and publication safety without replaying functional work. Publication-only fixes reuse matching evidence; functional edits invalidate it. loom-design and loom-workflow are optional and read this plugin's versioned contract package.
